Buy the course, €189 Lifetime access, one payment Level Intermediate Lessons 14 Duration 5 h 20 min Includes Video and working files (About the course) This is the course I wish I had when I left the agency. It follows one real identity project from start to finish, with the sketches, the dead ends and the client emails left in. Every lesson is recorded over my shoulder, in the studio, on the actual files. You get those files too, so you can pull them apart at your own pace. What you will be able to do 01 Turn a vague brief into one clear sentence to design against 02 Sketch and choose a mark without endless rounds 03 Build type, colour and layout rules that hold up across media 04 Present, deliver and write guidelines people actually use (Curriculum) 01 Brief and research 3 lessons, 1 h 5 min 1.1 Reading a brief 22 min 1.2 Research
